name: team-vibe-checker
description: A hilarious fake compatibility test for team members

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd backend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.backend:lint: cd backend && npm run lint || true
scripts.frontend:lint: cd frontend && npm run lint || true
scripts.test: npm run backend:test && npm run frontend:test
scripts.backend:test: cd backend && npm run test || true
scripts.frontend:test: cd frontend && npm run test || true
scripts.lint: npm run backend:lint && npm run frontend:lint
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ..
